tagline: One person in China. A direct connection for your purchase.
description: An independent, one-person sourcing and trading business in China. I find products, communicate with suppliers and arrange international shipping for individual and business buyers.
hero_title:
Your person in China.
For the things you need.
hero_note: I run a one-person sourcing and trading business in China. Tell me what you need, and I’ll work through the suppliers, product details and shipping options with you.
about: I run this business myself. My work is to find the products you need within China’s supply chain, talk to suppliers and help turn your request into a purchase that can be shipped overseas. I buy and resell goods, so yes, I’m a middleman. What I bring is flexibility: I can search across categories, work from an unusual reference and stay involved in the details from your first question to the shipping arrangements.
